name: Bloodmage Thalnos
summary: In the Scarlet Monastery's Graveyard, Bloodmage Thalnos haunts the tombs, hungry for vengeance. The plague of undeath claimed him, and he remains deep within the Crusade's holy grounds.

sections.title: A Mage Risen in Death
sections.body: No record tells who Thalnos was in life. The plague of undeath claimed him, and he rose as a withered skeleton. Still, he clings to fiery magic and arcane mastery. He cries out for vengeance and more souls.

sections.title: Master of the Graveyard
sections.body: From the deepest corner of the monastery's courtyard tombs, Thalnos commands apparitions and shambling undead minions. He attacks anyone who disturbs his domain. Beneath the Crusade's sacred halls, his presence is a bitter contradiction. He embodies the horror they swore to eradicate.

faq.answer: Bloodmage Thalnos haunts the Scarlet Monastery's graveyard as a skeletal spellcaster. No record tells who he was in life; the plague of undeath claimed him, and he rose as an undead mage hungry for vengeance.

faq.q: Why is an undead skeleton allowed in the Scarlet Monastery?
aliases: why does scarlet crusade keep thalnos
faq.answer: The Crusade executes undead on sight, yet Thalnos remains at the far end of the Graveyard among risen crypts and spirits. He prowls his own blighted domain rather than walking freely among the living crusaders.
Thalnos commands fiery spells and shadow magic. He also summons vengeful spirits and walking dead to overwhelm trespassers in the graveyard.
Thalnos's mortal lineage is uncertain. The title Bloodmage alone does not establish that he was a blood elf.

aliases: the dark side of the light thalnos
faq.answer: Thalnos is hostile to intruders in the monastery's graveyard. No specific commission to kill him is established for this era.

angles.text: As a mage, Thalnos shows how the plague can twist a gifted spellcaster into a vengeful being who still wields fire and shadow.
As a member of the Horde, you may see in Thalnos what the Forsaken escaped: an undead mage with no will left but vengeance, lurking in the heart of the Scarlet Crusade's monastery.
As a priest, you see in Thalnos among the tombs an unsettling sign that the Crusade's zeal has not kept darkness from its holy ground.
